description: React component 'CredentialInputHandler' for managing credential selection, editing, and dialogs in a UI, including API calls and permission checks.

methods.name: editCredential
methods.description: Sets dialog properties to edit a credential and shows the dialog.

methods.name: addAsyncOption
methods.description: Fetches credential data and opens dialogs to add new credentials.

methods.name: onConfirmAsyncOption
methods.description: Handles confirmation of credential selection, updates state, and triggers onSelect callback.

methods.name: onCredentialSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of a credential from the list and opens the add dialog.
